description.en: A whale-girl companion for DeepSeek Harness with 45 achievements, daily quests, three mini-games, 92 artworks, 620 dialogue lines, a growth journal, per-tool work poses, cross-device save export/import and accessibility mode. Local-first, no telemetry; verified on DSH desktop 0.2.0-rc.2, compatible with 0.2.1-rc.1/rc.2 and legacy 0.1.x web.
description.zh: 鲸鱼娘桌宠：45 项成就、每日任务、三个小游戏、92 张立绘、620 条台词、成长日记、按工具类型切换工作姿态、跨端存档导出/导入与无障碍模式。全本地、无遥测；已在 DSH 桌面端 0.2.0-rc.2 验收，兼容 0.2.1-rc.1/rc.2 与旧版 0.1.x Web。
